work.author: ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CLXXXI, addressed to Cardinal Morozzo of Novara, the archbishops of Turin and Genoa and the bishops of Vigevano and Annecy (LF29531–29536), constitutes them an ecclesiastical commission (apostolic delegation) for the continental Sardinian dominions under Morozzo's presidency, grants inquiry faculties and closes with blessing and the complete 28 September 1832 dating clause at LF29858, before numeral CLXXXII at LF29861. Issuer evidence is ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI. at LF29476–29476; the source closing at LF29855–29858 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo secundo, pontiticatus Nostri anno secundo: LF29549 is footnote 1 (Ex Bullario Romano) owned by this act (marker at LF29528) and is excluded as furniture; LF29701 (ge ,) is the garbled top-left page number of source page 192 by native position. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
